# §6 Portal Engagement — Highlight Candidates

1. **Strong session engagement** — Portal visitors average 5+ minute sessions across December 2025 through May 2026, suggesting active product research and catalog browsing by the dealer network. [→ §portal]
2. **Consistent daily visitor base** — Average daily unique visitors held in the 8–12 range across all seven reporting months, reflecting stable dealer portal adoption. [→ §portal]
3. **February pageview peak** — Pageview volume reached 2,747 in February 2026 — more than double the December 2025 level — before settling to roughly 1,200–1,500 per month through spring. [→ §portal]
